.name: Search my Steam library
.note: Search the active Steam library with optional filters and pagination. Return AppID, game name, playtime, and nextStart.
.description: Search the active Steam library with optional filters and pagination. Return AppID, game name, playtime, and nextStart.
.parameters.1.description: Start at zero. Use nextStart for the next page.
.parameters.2.description: Game modes: single, multiplayer, coop, local_multiplayer.
.parameters.3.description: Library status: ready, installed, played, unplayed, private.
.parameters.4.description: Supported languages, e.g. schinese, english, japanese.
.parameters.5.description: Genres: action, adventure, casual, indie, massively_multiplayer, racing, rpg, simulation, sports, strategy.
.parameters.6.description: Controller support: controller_recommended, controller_full, controller_partial, dualshock, dualshock_bluetooth, dualsense, dualsense_bluetooth, steam_input.
.parameters.7.description: Steam Deck compatibility: deck_verified, deck_playable, deck_unsupported, deck_unknown.
.parameters.9.description: Steam features: trading_cards, workshop, achievements, remote_play, family_sharing.
.parameters.10.description: Steam Store tag names or numeric tag IDs as strings.
.parameters.11.description: Exact names or friend codes of Steam friends who own the game.
.parameters.13.description: Visual accessibility: adjustable_text, subtitles, color_alternatives, contrast, camera_comfort, playable_without_vision.
.parameters.14.description: Audio accessibility: custom_volume, stereo, surround, narrated_menus.
.parameters.15.description: Input accessibility: keyboard_only, mouse_only, touch_only, without_quick_time, own_pace, speech_to_text, text_to_speech.
